name: notambourine
description: Claude Code plugins for the NoTambourine consulting practice.

plugins.name: nt-brand
plugins.description: NoTambourine brand source of truth. /nt-brand:system ships the tokens, components, fonts, and voice, plus the audit that checks copy against them.

plugins.name: nt-dev
plugins.description:
Everyday development workflow: /nt-dev:pr writes a PR body against the template, /nt-dev:cleanup audits a repo for drift, /nt-dev:md-format wraps and tidies markdown at a width you pick, /nt-dev:recall reads a prior session back into context, /nt-dev:issue writes a GitHub issue to the house standard, /nt-dev:eod-update writes a copy-paste end-of-day standup update from today's GitHub activity (never posts), and the Attentive output style trades asking for acting, then reports what changed. Three hooks back the skills up: one unwraps a PR body so GitHub does not render its line breaks as
, one points a bare gh call at the skill holding the house standard, and one names every line where a write raises the unicode-dash count, so the dash gate never fails the PR.

plugins.name: nt-pm
plugins.description: Plain-English status updates for a non-technical audience: /nt-pm:shipped summarizes what is about to ship (promotion or current branch vs the default branch) or what just shipped (the last push to the default branch, read from the reflog), grouped by category; /nt-pm:weekly-recap summarizes the week's merged, in-review, and in-progress work across the whole team. Never posts, never deploys.

plugins.name: nt-voice
plugins.description: One door to the prose voice pass. /nt-voice:human-voice claims every way of asking - "sounds like AI", "slop", "humanize this", "editorial pass" - then picks surgical or rewrite and hands off to the vendored skill that does that job. Needs nt-vendor.

plugins.name: nt-vendor
plugins.description: Third-party skills mirrored whole from their upstream repos, kept here so our own skills can call them by name. The nt-vendor prefix marks every skill in it as someone else's work.

plugins.name: wormhook
plugins.description: Blocks npm/PyPI supply-chain malware and agent-hijack persistence at the Claude Code hook — before it can run.

plugins.name: qrspi
plugins.description: GitHub-native structured feature development: Query, Research, Spec, Plan, Implement.

plugins.name: nt-share
plugins.description: Share a file, folder, or screenshot as one branded, unguessable link on share.notambourine.com. Browsers get a rendered page, curl and Slack unfurls get raw bytes from the same URL. Needs a NoTambourine-issued token.
